# `core/compression/CompressionUtils.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/compression/CompressionUtils.js`

CompressionUtils.js - Unified Compression Utilities Provides compression techniques for various data types: - Variable-Length Integer Encoding (VLInt) - Quantization (Float32 → Int16/Int8) - Run-Length Encoding (RLE) - Delta Compression - Octahedral Normal Encoding - Quaternion Compression Based on research from particle snapshot compression achieving 390x compression

## Functions

### `packVLInt(values)`

Pack small integers into fewer bytes using variable-length encoding Most indices are small, so we can use 1-2 bytes instead of 4 Encoding: - 1 byte: 0xxxxxxx (0-127) - 2 bytes: 10xxxxxx xxxxxxxx (128-16,383) - 3 bytes: 11xxxxxx xxxxxxxx xxxxxxxx (16,384-4,194,303)

### `unpackVLInt(packed)`

Unpack variable-length encoded integers

### `quantizeFloat(value, range)`

Quantize float to int16 within range [-range, +range] Achieves 50% memory reduction with minimal precision loss

### `dequantizeFloat(quantized, range)`

Dequantize int16 back to float

### `quantizeFloatArray(floats, range)`

Quantize array of floats to Int16Array

### `dequantizeFloatArray(quantized, range)`

Dequantize Int16Array back to Float32Array

### `quantizeToInt8(value, range)`

Quantize to int8 for even more compression (75% reduction) Use for data that doesn't need high precision (normals, colors)

### `dequantizeFromInt8(quantized, range)`

### `encodeOctahedralNormal(nx, ny, nz)`

Encode 3D unit normal to 2D octahedral coordinates Industry-standard technique used in AAA games Reference: "A Survey of Efficient Representations for Independent Unit Vectors"

### `decodeOctahedralNormal(x, y)`

Decode octahedral coordinates back to 3D normal

### `encodeNormalArray(normals)`

Encode array of normals (vec3) to Int16Array Input: Float32Array [nx, ny, nz, nx, ny, nz, ...] Output: Int16Array [x, y, x, y, ...] (66% smaller)

### `decodeNormalArray(encoded)`

Decode array of normals back to Float32Array

### `compressQuaternion(x, y, z, w)`

Compress quaternion by dropping smallest component Technique: Store 3 largest components + index of dropped component Used in animation systems for skeletal rigs

### `decompressQuaternion(compressed)`

Decompress quaternion by reconstructing dropped component

### `runLengthEncode(values)`

Run-Length Encode an array of values Perfect for voxel data with large empty regions Returns: [[value, count], [value, count], ...]

### `runLengthDecode(runs)`

Decode run-length encoded data

### `runLengthEncodeCompact(values)`

RLE with VLInt encoding for maximum compression Returns Uint8Array: [value, count, value, count, ...]

### `deltaEncode(values)`

Delta encode array (store differences instead of absolute values) Great for temporal data or sorted indices

### `deltaDecode(deltas)`

Decode delta-encoded array

### `createPalette(values)`

Create palette from array of values Returns: { palette: unique values, indices: array of palette indices }

### `decodePalette(palette, indices)`

Decode palette-compressed data

### `getCompressionStats(originalSize, compressedSize)`

Calculate compression ratio and statistics

### `formatBytes(bytes)`

Format bytes for display
